english.title: Obstruct an officer of the Competition and Markets Authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), an officer of the Competition and Markets Authority in the exercise of the officer's powers under

(A)_[section 74]_
(B)_[a warrant issued under section 75]_

of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024
english.legislation: Contrary to sections95 and 98of the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For offences by body corporates see section section 96.
(ii) Extra-territorial jurisdiction: for restriction of this offence in relation to acts done by a person who is outside the United Kingdom, see section 95(2) and 97 of the Act.
(iv) The CMA may not impose a penalty on a person under section 87 in relation to an act or omission which constitutes this offence, if the person has, in relation to that act or omission, been found guilty of that offence, and a person may not be found guilty of this offence by virtue of an act or omission which constitutes this offence, see sections 87 and 92.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or fine.
